# Dale OS

> Agentic operating system for high-integrity software and finance. Authority before autonomy. Real fixes to real problems. Null is not failure; false certainty is. Get the money right.

## Start here
- AGENTS.md — machine-first entry point and task router
- machine/explanation-contract.json — canonical repo-level explanation contract; read this before answering “what is this repo?”
- INSTALL.md — preview/install/pin/update guidance
- README.md — human overview
- PRINCIPLES.md — operating floor
- machine/failure-classes.json — shortest symptom-to-skill route
- machine/library.json — every skill shelved by domain and lane, with call numbers
- docs/LIBRARY.md — the theme and how the shelves work
- machine/compositions.json — narrow multi-skill recipes and handoff contracts
- machine/agent-index.json — machine discovery contract
- manifest.json — machine-readable skill catalog
- CHALLENGE.md — adversarial quick test
- ARCHITECTURE.md — one-source/many-adapters design

## Proof
- evals/ — adversarial fixtures, activation corpus, and behavioral tests
- cases/ — sanitized incidents that paid for rules
- docs/TESTING.md — validation contract
- docs/MODEL_EVAL_PROTOCOL.md — cross-runtime model evidence contract
- docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_READINESS.md — fail-closed public release contract
